verdict.rationale: A long-time user reports that Raygun's client providers (SDKs) are open source and that they wrote their own NancyFX provider from them, so some product source is readable. A comparison with Sentry implies Raygun's core platform codebase is not open source. missing for 10: an open-source core platform, first-party documentation of source repositories, a named open license, current (non-2013) corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: because the providers are open source they were able to write a NancyFX-specific provider
